LanguageData.LP_DT_PsychicShock.label: psychic jolt
LanguageData.LP_DT_PsychicShock.description: Pour far-realm whispers into others' minds: enemies in a 5-cell cone ahead are stunned for 2 seconds and take 15 psychic damage. 3 per day (restored 1 day after being used up).
LanguageData.LP_DT_Beastshape.label: shift into beast
LanguageData.LP_DT_Beastshape.description: A lycanthrope who has tamed the wildness can transform voluntarily for 6 hours without losing control. Once per day.
